summary: This page gives each paragraph a class so the CSS file can show a different color format or unit on each one.
notes: The class names describe what each line demonstrates, which makes the CSS easier to read.
The text in each paragraph matches the value the CSS uses, so you can compare them.
Colors and sizes live in the CSS file, not in the HTML.
pitfall: Trying to set colors in HTML with old attributes like <font color="red">. That tag is obsolete; use CSS.
